source: ops-cv upsample_nearest3d aclnn 实测（warmup=3, repeats=3, msprof --ai-core task_time 中值）; measured impl = /home/zzy-work/refgen_perf_audit/adapters/ref_15_upsample_nearest3d.py. Caliber: warmup=25, repeats=10, per-case msprof capture, trailing-10 mean; | 2026-09-15 case 重设（放大 shape 命中目标分档）后按本管线口径全量重测；新增 latency_band_distribution。
caliber: warmup=25, repeats=10, per-case msprof capture, trailing-10 mean; gap-fenced iteration segmentation (instrumented sync+sleep separator, floor 9 ms); convergence gate = |drift| <= 5% on mean(2nd half of last 10)/mean(1st half), judged separately for e2e and core

window_mix.note: extended_cases were re-measured ONLY after failing the convergence gate at the modal window; no case that already passed was re-rolled. paired_ab_bound_pct is the largest per-case move seen in a same-case paired A/B between the modal and the extended window (null = not established for this operator, which is NOT the same as zero).

cases.flops_note: upsample_nearest3d: 2097152 out elems x 1 flop/elem (gather) + 262144 spatial x 6 flop (3 axes x mul+floor); no weight, no interpolation. Measured engine profile (kept op_summary, 5 cases spanning 8 -> 1M output elems; each figure is a RANGE in pct of aiv_time): vector ALU 7.8-14.6, scalar 58.9-78.7, MTE2 5.6-34.5, MTE3 3.4-40.4. These ratios DRIFT with size (small kernels are launch/latency dominated), so read them as a range, not as an operator constant. Scalar leads at every size and the vector ALU never exceeds 15 pct, so mfu_pct is a secondary figure even on the correct (vector) peak; unlike 19's gather (scalar 99.9 pct, single-port) no one pipe is saturated -- read it with achieved_bw_gbs
